Subject: Update on Your Budget Increase Request

Dear [Name],

Thank you for submitting your request for a budget increase for your department. After careful review, we have decided not to approve the request at this time. The justification provided does not currently align with the company's broader financial strategy.

However, we encourage you to resubmit your proposal. To improve the chances of approval, please include a more detailed explanation along with concrete examples of the anticipated benefits.

Best regards,

[Your Name]

The home mountain of the Greek Gods is Mount Olympus.
